task.description:
Run the EE-02 unit tests and produce a test report.

1. Run `zig build test` — capture output.
2. Verify all TC-EE-02-01 through TC-EE-02-11 tests are present and pass.
3. Write a test report to `tests/reports/EE-02-test-run.json` per the test guide §8 format:
   - Include run timestamp, zig build test exit code, pass/fail counts, per-test-case results.
4. If any tests fail: set result.status to FAIL and list issues with severity.
5. If all pass: set result.status to PASS.

Complete the handoff when done.
